_comment: Configure the 4-step welcome message drip sequence sent when a prospect accepts a friend request.
_variables_guide: You can use {name} (prospect display name), {username} (prospect handle), {server} (origin server), {sender} (sender handle), {name display} (sender display name).

messages.message: Hello, welcome to {server}, how are you doing?

Before we continue, for security reasons and to protect our community from unwanted interactions, I recommend blocking impersonators from sending you DMs. Due to the recent increase in spam messages and unwanted invite links, I'll send you a guide on how to do so, i hope that'll be find by you?
Turn of the highlighted icons, let me know when you’ve done that.
